Subject: Post-call: BrightRoute pricing check + model priority (tokens & splits)

Thanks again for the call this morning — quick recap and two asks to keep momentum.

High-level from our notes (please correct if I've misread):
- Expected steady-state token volume: ~3.2B tokens / month (spikey first quarter)
- Primary use-cases: in-app chat (customer-facing), embeddings for semantic search, and a small reranking pipeline for QA results
- Initial procurement timeline: decision in August, technical onboarding in September if approved

As discussed, two items we need from you to finalize a model mix and draft a pricing proposal: 
1) Confirm the monthly token band you'd be comfortable committing to (e.g., 2–4B, 4–8B) and any seasonality.
2) Give us a target blended $/1M tokens you want us to design to (we'll show a few model-split scenarios to hit that target).

What we'll deliver after we get the above: a short pricing scenarios memo with per-model unit economics (chat / embeddings / rerank), two routing options (cost-first vs latency-first), and a recommended default split for pilot.

Attached: BrightRoute_MonthlyVolumes.xlsx — I filled in the rough monthly distribution based on your comments.

Next steps: if you can reply with a quick confirmation on the band and target $/1M by EOD tomorrow, Jonas and I will turn around scenario A/B by Friday.

Cheers,

Thanks Marissa — quick answers inline.

Confirming volumes: we expect ~3.2B tokens/month as a base. We see seasonal spikes up to ~4.5B in November. For procurement we can commit to a 3–4B band initially, with the ability to re-baseline after Q4.

Target blended cost: we'd like proposals built to a target around $3,200 / 1M tokens (range $2,800–$3,600). That target is driven by internal ROI thresholds.

Model mix we currently anticipate (rough):
- Chat (customer-facing conversations): ~65–70% of tokens
- Embeddings (semantic search / vector store updates): ~20–25%
- Rerank (pairwise scoring and QA boost): ~5–10%

Question: for rerank we care about 50–150ms p95 latency on the scoring path — can you call that out in your scenarios? Also, do you have recommendations for batching or pre-computing for rerank to reduce unit cost?

Happy to confirm the band formally once we see the scenario A/B.

Sam Lee
Head of ML Platforms | BrightRoute
sam@brightroute.ai | +1 (408) 555-0142
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Lee <sam@brightroute.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-28T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Pricing scenarios (sketch) — hitting $3.2k target w/ two split options

Sam — thanks, good constraints. Attached is a short sketch (SLA-draft.pdf) and my quick math below — this is intentionally pragmatic (rounded) so we can iterate.

Assumptions (baseline models / unit rates):
- Chat (optimized routing, gpt-chat-cpu/gpu mix): $2.80 / 1M tokens
- Embeddings (dense vector generation, quantized): $6.40 / 1M tokens
- Rerank (pairwise scoring, small model + batching): $1.10 / 1M tokens

Scenario A — Latency-priority (keep chat heavy on low-latency variants):
- Chat 70% | Embeddings 20% | Rerank 10%
- Blended cost = (0.70*$2.80) + (0.20*$6.40) + (0.10*$1.10) = $3.02 / 1M tokens

Scenario B — Cost-priority (shift embeddings offline + batched rerank):
- Chat 60% | Embeddings 30% (batched/offline cheaper effective cost) | Rerank 10%
- Effective embeddings with offline precompute: $5.00 / 1M tokens (after batching/quant)
- Blended cost = (0.60*$2.80) + (0.30*$5.00) + (0.10*$1.10) = $3.19 / 1M tokens

Notes & operational levers:
- Embeddings: batching window and vector quantization can move effective $/1M between ~$4.5–6.8 depending on freshness SLA and vector dimension.
- Rerank: if you can tolerate micro-batching (5–50 ms window) and use pairwise prunes, effective cost drops substantially; worst-case single-request scoring costs above are conservative.
- Routing: we can route low-latency chat to dedicated pools and burst to lower-cost variants for non-interactive jobs (e.g., digest generation).

Recommendation: because your target is $3.2k and you care about p95 latency on customer chat, we recommend Scenario A as the pilot default (meets latency, slightly below target). Scenario B is the play if you want to optimize to the higher end of the range while moving more work offline.

Next steps I propose:
1) Sam/Elena to confirm preferred scenario (A or B) and commit band (3–4B).
2) If confirmed, we'll produce a two-page commercial proposal + routing config and a 60-minute technical onboarding slot (proposal + perf baseline).
3) We'll include an SLA stub (attached) with p95 latency targets for chat and rerank.

—Jonas
